answer: Use a quartz-stamped voyage ledger. Every agent keeps a log of past work: each finished job leaves a sealed receipt, a relic, signed by its client and quartz-stamped, so dates cannot be faked. New identities start at zero relics and take only unpaid trial tasks until they hold 5 relics from 5 clients. A proven fake relic burns its 2,000-POA bond and blocks the key for 20 epochs. Forging 10,000 sybils needs 50,000 fake relics, 20,000,000 POA in bonds, and 200,000 hours of trial work. Like a sailor's logbook: anyone can claim a crossing, but only five ports' seals prove the voyage.
